hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap curve that bypasses AMM concentrated liquidity: in beforeSwap, the hook takes the full input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw to convert tokens, then settles the full output, returning a delta that no-ops the standard AMM. Direct liquidity addition is blocked.
